_doc: Golden cases for skills/blurt/scripts/organize_prompt.json: what the macOS app (BlurtCoreTests OrganizerPromptTests) and the Windows/Linux app (agents.rs tests) must both make of each input. Regenerate the prompts when a part of the template changes; both tests read this file.

cases.name: recording into a project
cases.prompt:
Use the blurt skill to process this recording: /Users/a/r/atlas/.blurt/sessions/20261118-101500
This is an unattended background run started by the Blurt app: don't ask questions and don't start the review page. Write items.json and run items.py ingest as SKILL.md says, then summarise in 2–3 sentences. If a script stops because a tool it needs isn't installed (its line says which one and how to install it), go no further: write no items.json, and end with that line.
The blurt skill: /Users/a/.blurt/skill/SKILL.md
Run the skill's scripts exactly as `uv run /Users/a/.blurt/skill/scripts/<name>.py …` (no other form, no other command is allowed).
The project's code (read it, change nothing there): /Users/a/r/atlas

cases.name: cards from the inbox, with candidates

input.candidates:
Candidate projects (suggest one per item; nothing moves):
- atlas — Atlas Web
- api — api-server
